eligible_cells: the same 15 exact publisher×category cells common to 2020 and 2021; no new cell discovery

counts.note: Counts are corpus support, not class balance; per-cell macro evaluation is mandatory.

development_split.method: SHA-256(doc_id || fixed salt) deterministic split within each 2020 publisher×category cell
development_split.temporal_holdout_access: 2021 embeddings/results unavailable until representation/pooling/evaluation contract is frozen

views.cell_macro: equal weight over 15 common publisher×category cells

first_court.R4a: frozen pretrained encoder(s), no AI-Hub parameter updates
first_court.R4b: adaptive/fine-tuned encoder only after R4a report is sealed
first_court.comparison: R4a vs R0/R1/R2/R6 on the P46 partial-order vector; no single accuracy leaderboard

prohibited: using 2021 to select encoder, layer, pooling, dimension or normalization
adding cells because 2021 results look favorable
year classification accuracy as semantic authority
source classification leakage interpreted as linguistic structure
post-hoc representation rotation from temporal-holdout outcomes
evaluation_minimum: R6 decision-distance on available counterfactual/decision cases
R2 typed-counterfactual selectivity where authority exists
